title: Pair the flat-file store with a SQLite index
context: Querying artifacts across the whole repository by scanning files does not scale past a few hundred tasks.
decision: Rebuild a SQLite index from the flat files on demand; the files remain the source of truth.
consequences: Queries stay fast as the number of artifacts grows.
The index can always be rebuilt from git history, so it never needs its own backup.

alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Git would no longer be the source of truth, breaking offline merge and review by diff.

alternativesConsidered.option: Keep scanning flat files on every query.
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Latency grows linearly with repository size and blocks the portal UI.
